concept: A frayed copper wire splitting into two paths—one leading upward toward a gleaming rocket caught mid-air by mechanical hands, the other descending into shadow and uncertainty. Bold, geometric shapes. High contrast. The wire itself forms the central composition, thick and prominent, with sharp angular light suggesting both breakthrough and breakdown. Duotone-friendly: strong silhouettes, minimal detail.
explanation: Today's news oscillates between triumph and dysfunction: SpaceX's historic rocket catch represents human ambition realized, while a single copper wire grounded the entire US aviation system—a metaphor for how fragile infrastructure underpins modern life. Meanwhile, geopolitical tensions (Ukraine, Uganda, Hungary) and privacy violations (Meta) suggest systems corroding from within. The wire bifurcation captures this duality: innovation soaring while basic competence fails.

headlines.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
headlines.summary: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments - a US official told the BBC "many ideas continue to be discussed".

headlines.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
headlines.summary: The US government is trying to find out whether the chaos was caused by "incompetence" or faulty equipment.

headlines.title: Pope Leo speaks of community 'suffering' on visit to remote Andes town
headlines.summary: Santa Cruz de Succhabamba is part of the Diocese of Chiclayo, where the pope served as bishop from 2015 to 2023.

headlines.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation
headlines.summary: It is the latest development in a months-long challenge to the president's plans for East Potomac Golf Links.

headlines.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
headlines.summary: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.

headlines.title: 'Can you believe it?': SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
headlines.summary: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

headlines.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
headlines.summary: Front-runner Carmelle emerges victorious with her women's empowerment anthem Sobra-Sobra.

headlines.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'
headlines.summary: Sotheby's says it will work with the heirs of a family who had previously owned the artwork to try and reach a solution.

headlines.title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever
headlines.summary: The 52-year-old general’s provocative posts and military threats have fuelled rumours of a dynastic succession.

headlines.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia's main airport due to altitude
headlines.summary: The foreign ministry in Abuja says 6 Nigerians with underlying health problems have died this year while transiting through Addis Ababa.

headlines.title: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

headlines.title: 'We'll get home one day' - US travellers impacted by nationwide ground stop
headlines.summary: Passengers throughout the country were impacted over what the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) describes as “safety and communication issues”.
